prompt: This EUDA initial report on NEP (N-ethylnorpentedrone) is cited for the items below. Report each exactly as printed, with all digits, and say 'not found' for any that is absent: (a) the number of law-enforcement cases in powder form and the total number of cases in 2013-2024; (b) the total quantity of powder seized in 2013-2024; (c) the quantity of powder seized in 2024, and whether that figure is the total for 2024 or only imports from India into the Netherlands. Do not quote any passage longer than 15 words.
answer:
**(a) Powder cases and total cases, 2013-2024:** 6 473 powder cases (96.4% of all cases), out of 6 714 seizures and imports (cases) containing NEP across all physical forms.

**(b) Total powder quantity seized, 2013-2024:** 11 105.399 kg (11.1 tonnes). This figure covers the 6 224 powder cases that reported weight.

**(c) Quantity seized in 2024:** The report gives 5 970 kg for 2024, but it does not clearly say whether this is the total for 2024 or only imports from India into the Netherlands. The sentence containing it refers to Netherlands imports from India: "with 5 970 kg (53.7%) reported in 2024 alone." However, the 53.7% is calculated against the total quantity, and Section 1 reports 6 tonnes of NEP seized and imported in 2024 overall. These points suggest the figure is the 2024 total, but the report does not state this explicitly.
